sn35.169:1.1: Chandena Yam bhikkhave aniccaṃ tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo || kiñca bhikkhave aniccaṃ || || Cakkhum bhikkhave aniccaṃ tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo || || Sotaṃ || || Ghānam || || Jivhā aniccā tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo || || Kāyo anicco Mano anicco tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo || || Yam bhikkhave aniccaṃ tatra vo rāgo pahātabboti || ||
